setup.remedy.admin_approval_required: Ask a Global Administrator or Privileged Role Administrator to run the setup, or set up by hand.
setup.remedy.app_key_invalid: Check that APP_KEY or APP_KEY_FILE holds the exact key that was used before, and restart the container. Use the rotate-app-key command to change the key.
setup.remedy.app_key_missing: Generate a key with the generate-app-key command, set APP_KEY or APP_KEY_FILE, and restart the container.
setup.remedy.app_role_missing: Run the step again. If the permission is still missing, give the log lines of this step to your administrator.
setup.remedy.application_adoption_requir: Check the application shown here. Adopt it only if you recognise it; otherwise choose another application name.
setup.remedy.application_ambiguous: Rename or delete the duplicates in Microsoft Entra, or choose another application name in the connect step, and run the step again.
setup.remedy.application_untrusted: The panel does not adopt it, because that secret would give access to everything the panel is allowed to do. Delete the application in Microsoft Entra, or choose another application name, and run the step again.
setup.remedy.assignment_required: Ask your Microsoft Entra administrator to assign the account to that application, or sign in with another administrator account.
setup.remedy.bootstrap_failed: Try again. If it keeps failing, set up by hand and give your administrator the Microsoft code shown here, if there is one.
setup.remedy.bootstrap_role_insufficient: Sign in with an administrator who holds the role Privileged Role Administrator (or Global Administrator) and may register applications, or set up by hand.
setup.remedy.consent_required: Sign in with an account that may give consent for the organisation, such as Privileged Role Administrator or Global Administrator, or set up by hand.
setup.remedy.data_dir_not_writable: Check that the data volume is mounted, has free space and is writable by user 65532 (for example with chown on the host folder), then check again.
setup.remedy.device_code_blocked: A Conditional Access policy probably blocks this. Ask an administrator for a temporary exception for the person who runs the setup, or set up by hand.
setup.remedy.device_code_cancelled: Start the sign-in again when you are ready.
setup.remedy.device_code_declined: Start the sign-in again and accept the request, or set up by hand if your organisation does not allow this sign-in.
setup.remedy.device_code_expired: Start the sign-in again and finish it at Microsoft within the time shown.
setup.remedy.drift_detected: Repair the connection in Settings, Connection. The panel only adds what is missing; it never removes permissions by itself.
setup.remedy.exchange_not_ready: Microsoft needs time after a role assignment. Verify again in a few minutes. You can finish the setup now and verify later.
setup.remedy.exchange_service_principal_: Distribution lists and contacts need Exchange Online. If your tenant has it, repair the connection later in Settings, Connection.
setup.remedy.exchange_unavailable: Distribution lists and contacts need it. Verify again later, or repair the connection. You can finish the setup now.
setup.remedy.forbidden_permission_presen: Remove that permission from the application in Microsoft Entra (the panel never removes permissions by itself), then run the step again.
setup.remedy.foreign_credential_present: Review them in Microsoft Entra. The panel never removes them by itself. Whoever holds them can act with the permissions of the panel.
setup.remedy.graph_error: Run the step again. If it keeps failing, give the log lines of this step and the Microsoft code, if shown, to your administrator.
setup.remedy.group_unknown: Search for the group again and choose it from the list, or leave the group empty.
setup.remedy.network_exchange_unreachabl: Allow outgoing HTTPS to outlook.office365.com. You can continue, but distribution lists and contacts will not work until this is fixed.
setup.remedy.network_unreachable: Allow outgoing HTTPS from the container to login.microsoftonline.com and graph.microsoft.com (proxy or firewall), then check again.
setup.remedy.node_version_unsupported: Use the official image of this panel, which contains a supported version. You can continue, but the panel is not tested on this version.
setup.remedy.not_checked: It needs a fresh sign-in at Microsoft. Repair the connection with a new sign-in if you want it included.
setup.remedy.optional_claim_missing: Repair the connection: that registers them. Without amr the panel cannot check multi-factor authentication while AUTH_REQUIRE_MFA is on.
setup.remedy.organization_mismatch: Sign in with an account of the right tenant, or start a new installation on a new data volume.
setup.remedy.owner_changed: Check who signed in during the setup, then confirm the Owner shown here again. If the wrong person signed in, repeat the sign-in step.
setup.remedy.owner_missing: Complete the earlier steps first, or enter the first Owner when you set up by hand.
setup.remedy.policy_refused: Microsoft refused the change, for example because of an application management policy that restricts certificates. Ask your Microsoft Entra administrator to allow it for this application, or set up by hand.
setup.remedy.public_base_url_invalid: Set PUBLIC_BASE_URL to the address people use to open the panel, for example https://panel.example.com, and restart the container.
setup.remedy.replication_timeout: Microsoft needs some time to spread new settings. Choose “Try again now”, or wait a few minutes and run the step again.
setup.remedy.tenant_mismatch: Sign in with an account of the connected tenant. Switching tenants means a new installation on a new data volume.
setup.remedy.thumbprint_mismatch: Run the step again so that the certificate of the panel is added, or repair the connection in Settings.
setup.remedy.time_skew_excessive: Synchronise the clock of the host (NTP) and check again. Until then Microsoft rejects the tokens of the panel.
setup.remedy.time_skew_warning: Synchronise the clock of the host (NTP). Sign-in tokens depend on the time, so a bigger difference makes signing in fail.
setup.remedy.token_unavailable: Wait a few minutes, because Microsoft may still be applying the changes, and verify again. If it keeps failing, repair the connection.
setup.remedy.users_unreadable: Check that the permission User.Read.All is granted to the application (repair the connection in Settings), then verify again.
